_comment: Bedrock engine table, not shipped in any pack: render controllers vanilla client entities name and no file of the vanilla resource pack defines (the only one in bedrock-samples v1.26.60.5, whose files define 213). The iron golem's draws its body: its other controller, controller.render.iron_golem_cracks, draws only the crack overlays (cracked_none is empty), so this one is inferred to be the default controller, the entity's default geometry, material and texture.
